# MakeMyCut

> Skip the wait. Book haircuts, barbers, and salons instantly — no calls, no queues.

MakeMyCut is an instant salon booking and live-queue platform. Customers discover verified barbers and salons by district and area, book a time slot in seconds, or join the in-shop queue digitally and get notified when it's their turn. All bookings are pay-at-salon.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Discover salons, book instantly, or join a live queue.
- [Trivandrum salons](/salons/trivandrum): Top salons across Trivandrum district.
- [Salons in Attingal](/salons/trivandrum/attingal): Verified salons in Attingal, Trivandrum.

## Optional

- [Customer sign in](/auth): Email or Google sign-in for customers.
- [Salon owner sign in](/salon-login): Dashboard access for salon owners.
